QuestInfo.name: [Mushroom Shrine Tales] Oni Surprise
QuestInfo.0: You run into #p9111002# hanging around Grieving Grotto. You should talk to him.
QuestInfo.1: #p9111002# tells you that he was wandering around Zipangu and came all the way to Grieving Grotto when he heard something weird was going on. The Skeletal Samurai sees you talking with #p9111002# and approaches you.
QuestInfo.2: The Skeletal Samurai attacked they found out you were investigating #p9111004#. Something unusual is definitely going on here.
